title: Defect Triangles and Intersection-Space Hodge Atom Shadows for Calabi--Yau Conifolds
summary: We prove a projection-triangle statement for projective Calabi--Yau threefold conifold degenerations and use it to organize an intersection-space Hodge atom shadow package. For a nodal central fiber $X_0$, assume the relevant Banagl--Budur--Maxim, multi-node gluing, mixed-Hodge-module, and specialization-splitting hypotheses, so that $ψ_π(F)\simeq \mathcal{IS}^{H}_{X_0}\oplus\mathcal C^H_Σ$.
